detail:
fnn-mux-budget-install (mux.lisp:1963) is called from the start path (owner.lisp:8737) and wraps its work in fnn-owner-serialized (owner.lisp:3048 -> fnn-section-run, O). Inside, mux.lisp:1976 calls fnn-heap-core-octets (heap.lisp:110) -> sb-posix:stat of sb-ext:*core-pathname*.
Key: R2|fnn-heap-core-octets|O:sb-posix:stat (2 sites). Held, reachable, one stat at startup before listening; hazard small (no serving threads yet) but fnn-heap-machine-octets (mux.lisp:1974, reads /proc or cgroup files via fnn-heap-observations) in the same argument list is the same shape and is not flagged, so the checker's list is not exhaustive for this thunk.
fix: Observe the machine and core figures before entering the section and pass them in (as fnn-owner-limit-serialized does for its observations, admin.lisp:~543), or declare as a startup-phase exception.
scenario: Start path only; a slow stat of the core delays startup under O, nothing else waits.
